name: Server Browser
description: A Chromium browser on the daemon host, shared by your phone, your computer and a dedicated browser agent, with explicit handover and one-tap access to ports your agents open. English, Simplified Chinese and user-defined languages.

zh-CN.name: 服务器浏览器
zh-CN.description: 在 daemon 主机上运行的 Chromium 浏览器，由手机、电脑和专用的浏览器 Agent 共用，控制权明确交接，Agent 打开的端口一点即开。支持英文、简体中文和用户自定义语言。
